mapper.sql: FROM invoice i JOIN application a ON a.id=i.application_id AND a.organization_id=i.organization_id JOIN `user` u ON u.cas_id=a.applicant_cas_id JOIN form_version fv ON fv.id=a.form_version_id AND fv.organization_id=a.organization_id JOIN application_form af ON af.id=fv.form_id AND af.organization_id=fv.organization_id JOIN project p ON p.id=af.project_id AND p.organization_id=af.organization_id LEFT JOIN dictionary_item category ON category.id=i.expense_category_item_id AND category.organization_id=i.organization_id LEFT JOIN paper_item pi ON pi.invoice_id=i.id AND pi.organization_id=i.organization_id
mapper.select:
SELECT i.id invoice_id,i.application_id,p.id project_id,p.name project_name, af.id form_id,af.name form_name,a.applicant_cas_id,u.name applicant_name, i.invoice_type,i.invoice_code,i.invoice_number,i.digital_invoice_no, i.invoice_date,i.seller_name,i.face_amount,i.claimed_amount, i.expense_category_item_id,category.display_name expense_category_name,i.status, COALESCE(pi.status,CASE WHEN p.paper_required=FALSE THEN 'NOT_REQUIRED' ELSE 'PENDING_SETUP' END) paper_status, i.version,i.updated_at
ORDER BY ${sortColumn} ${sortDirection},i.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) total,COALESCE(SUM(i.face_amount),0) total_face_amount, COALESCE(SUM(i.claimed_amount),0) total_claimed_amount

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1
WHERE i.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND i.id=#{invoiceId} AND (a.applicant_cas_id=#{actorCasId} OR #{unrestricted}=TRUE OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_manager pm JOIN organization_member m ON m.id=pm.member_id AND m.organization_id=pm.organization_id WHERE pm.organization_id=i.organization_id AND pm.project_id=p.id AND m.cas_id=#{actorCasId} AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND (m.term_start IS NULL OR m.term_start <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (m.term_end IS NULL OR m.term_end >= CURRENT_DATE)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_access pa JOIN organization_member m ON m.id=pa.member_id AND m.organization_id=pa.organization_id WHERE pa.organization_id=i.organization_id AND pa.project_id=p.id AND m.cas_id=#{actorCasId} AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND pa.access_type IN ('VIEW','REVIEW','MANAGE') AND (m.term_start IS NULL OR m.term_start <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (m.term_end IS NULL OR m.term_end >= CURRENT_DATE))) )
